feature: Project scaffold and documentation shell for commit-risk-investigator
problem: After legacy deletion, the repo has no source package, stale pyproject.toml referencing cr-analyzer, outdated README/ARCHITECTURE docs, and no docs/ directory. Need a clean scaffold for the investigative agent.
proposed_solution: Create src/commit_investigator/ package with __init__.py, rewrite pyproject.toml with new name and deps, rewrite README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md for investigative agent thesis, create docs/ with experiment-context.md, datasets.md, evaluation.md stubs.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: src/commit_investigator/__init__.py defines `__version__: str` matching PEP 440 (e.g. '0.1.0'); `python -c 'import commit_investigator; assert commit_investigator.__version__'` succeeds after install

AC-2: pyproject.toml [project] name='commit-investigator', version set, requires-python='>=3.12', description mentions commit investigation or risk assessment (case-insensitive) and does NOT contain 'ITSM', 'CAB', or '9-stage'
AC-3: pyproject.toml [project] dependencies include pydantic>=2.0, httpx, xgboost, scikit-learn (each as a separate dependency entry or pinned/minimum spec)
AC-4: pyproject.toml [project.optional-dependencies] dev includes pytest>=8.0, mypy>=1.10, ruff (each listed under dev)
AC-5: pyproject.toml [build-system] requires=['hatchling'] and build-backend='hatchling.build'; [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] packages=['src/commit_investigator']
AC-6: pyproject.toml has no reference to cr_analyzer, cr-analyzer, sentence-transformers, or testpaths=['tests'] pointing at deleted layout (testpaths may be absent or 'tests' for future feat-8)

AC-7: README.md has an H1 or H2 heading containing 'investigat' or 'commit risk' (case-insensitive); body mentions ApacheJIT; includes install instructions with literal `pip install -e .`; links to docs/experiment-context.md, docs/datasets.md, docs/evaluation.md using relative markdown links that resolve
AC-8: README.md does NOT contain (case-insensitive grep): 'cr_analyzer', 'BPI 2014', 'CAB', '9-stage', 'pipeline stages'

AC-9: ARCHITECTURE.md contains markdown H2 headings (##) whose titles collectively cover all four topics (each topic matchable in heading text, case-insensitive): (a) agent loop or orchestrator with max 3 turns, (b) XGBoost routing with thresholds 0.3 and 0.7, (c) GroundTruthGraph or ground truth chain bug_hash→fix_hash→issue_key, (d) CommitInvestigationReport or investigation report schema
AC-10: ARCHITECTURE.md mentions V1 scope: Camel and Hadoop as the two git-cloned projects; states agent framework choice is deferred

AC-11: docs/ directory contains exactly three markdown files: docs/experiment-context.md, docs/datasets.md, docs/evaluation.md — no docs/pipeline-flow.md, docs/glossary.md, or other stale pipeline docs

AC-12: docs/experiment-context.md has H1 or H2 sections covering: (a) investigative agent thesis vs classifier-only baseline, (b) five eval dimensions D1–D5 listed by ID with names prediction/localization/diagnosis/severity/recommendations, (c) harness cost governance (XGBoost scores all commits; LLM only on routed gray zone; budget tiers $10/$50/$100), (d) oracle isolation — JIRA/fix-commit data reserved for eval only, not agent context

AC-13: docs/datasets.md has a section heading containing 'ground truth' (case-insensitive) documenting chain bug_hash → fix_hash → issue_key; names commit_links_{PROJECT}.csv and {PROJECT}.csv file patterns; references data/apachejit/ and scripts/download_apachejit.sh

AC-14: docs/evaluation.md lists D1–D5 as a markdown list or table where each row/item includes dimension ID (D1..D5) and a one-line criterion aligned to state.json: D1 prediction vs buggy label, D2 localization vs fix diff files, D3 diagnosis vs JIRA description, D4 severity vs JIRA priority, D5 recommendations vs fix pattern; includes stub placeholders for results (e.g. TBD or pending feat-9)
AC-15: Grep scope {README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, pyproject.toml, docs/*.md, src/commit_investigator/**} finds zero matches (case-insensitive) for: cr_analyzer, cr-analyzer, BPI 2014, ITSM pipeline, CAB
AC-16: In a fresh venv: `pip install -e .` exit 0; then `python -c 'import commit_investigator; print(commit_investigator.__version__)'` exit 0 with non-empty stdout
edge_cases: EC-1: pyproject.toml is valid TOML parseable by Python 3.12 tomllib.loads() without error
EC-2: Every relative markdown link target in README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md (pattern ](...) excluding http/https/mailto) resolves to an existing file relative to repo root
EC-3: `git check-ignore -v data/apachejit/` exits 0 (data/ remains gitignored)
EC-4: scripts/download_apachejit.sh exists, is executable (mode includes x), and references Zenodo or apachejit dataset URL
EC-5: data/apachejit/ directory exists (preserved from chore-0; may contain CSVs or be empty placeholder — directory must exist)
EC-6: No src/cr_analyzer/ directory remains under repo root
EC-7: ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/experiment-context.md each contain at least 40 non-blank lines (prevents one-paragraph stubs)
verification_method: Evaluator runs: (1) file inventory — docs/ exact triple, no src/cr_analyzer; (2) tomllib parse pyproject.toml; (3) case-insensitive ripgrep on AC-8/AC-15 patterns; (4) heading/content grep for AC-9/AC-12/AC-13/AC-14 required terms; (5) markdown link resolver on README+ARCHITECTURE; (6) git check-ignore data/apachejit/; (7) fresh venv pip install -e . + import/version check; (8) line-count wc -l on ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/experiment-context.md.
